description: Swell Cabin's articles on where and when to surf: each answers a search surfers make (surf lessons in a town, surf camps in a country, the best months, where beginners should go), written from the site's own measured data (how often the surf was Good and Great in each month over three years, sea temperature from two satellites where they agree, the spots with their break and level, surf schools and places to stay mapped around the breaks) and pages it quotes, every number traced to one of them and read again by a separate review before it went up. With slug: one article in full (its Markdown body, the pages it was checked against and where its numbers come from). With town: the articles about that town. Otherwise the newest. Each article has its url, its page on swellcabin.com.

town.description: Town slug: only the articles about that town.
